summary: Iteration 12 verified the subscription-status / paywall-guard fixes (statusLoaded race, demo checkout confirmation, guard gating). ALL 5 review-request items PASS on the public preview URL (390x844). (1) HAPPY PATH: full onboarding -> /subscription?from=onboarding auth gate -> delivered@resend.dev OTP login (mongo code_hash override) -> plan step -> 'Start Free Trial' -> checkout -> 'Confirm Free Trial' -> demo POST /api/premium/activate returned is_premium:true -> landed on Home (greeting + tab bar); Settings shows YOUR PLAN 'Hera Annual'. User is premium, no paywall bounce. (2) COLD START: page.reload() as premium -> routed straight to Home (visited URLs: ['/'] only, NEVER /subscription) - statusLoaded race fixed. Re-verified with a second fresh premium user. (3) NON-PREMIUM GUARD: fresh OTP-registered user (is_premium=false, /api/subscription plan:'free') -> cold load visited ONLY /subscription, never leaked into tabs; direct /discover navigation bounced to /subscription; signed-in non-premium lands on the PLAN step (auth gate correctly skipped). (4) FAILURE PATH: simulated payment/backend failure (deleted user server-side so POST /api/premium/activate -> 401 'Invalid or expired token') -> tapping 'Confirm Free Trial' showed alert 'Something went wrong - Your trial could not be started... you have not been charged' and STAYED on /subscription checkout; no navigation to /(tabs), no Home leak. Code review confirms expoRouter.replace('/(tabs)') is only reached after `if (!res?.is_premium) throw`. (5) REGRESSION: full 25-screen onboarding -> auth gate intact; back-button memory (splash->welcome->Log in->/login->browser back->welcome, NOT splash) intact. BACKEND: new pytest suite 7/7 PASS (premium OTP login, /api/subscription premium=true, /api/auth/me is_premium, /premium/activate + /subscription require auth (401), fresh user non-premium->activate->persists (verified via GET /api/subscription AND /api/auth/me), activate idempotent). FIX APPLIED (minor label bug): profile.tsx:678,681 compared plan === 'annual' but Plan type is 'free'|'monthly'|'yearly', so the badge ALWAYS rendered '👑 Monthly' next to 'Hera Annual' - changed to 'yearly'; verified live (badge now '✨ Annual' + 'Hera Annual').

minor.issue: Under test load the upstream Emergent email relay returned 429 (rate_limited) and the app surfaced 502 'Failed to send email'. NOTE: the OTP record is inserted in mongo BEFORE send_email, so a user told 'failed to send' actually has a live code in DB (10-min window). Consider inserting the OTP only after successful send, or returning a clearer retryable error. Not a product bug in normal traffic - triggered by rapid test OTP requests.

Changed to plan === 'yearly'; verified '✨ Annual' + 'Hera Annual' render together.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix (a) verified: auto-check effect (SubscriptionContext.tsx:311-313) now runs checkSubscription on EVERY platform with no Platform.OS gate; web/simulator falls back to the server via the emergent-client shim (getSupabaseClient().functions.invoke('check-subscription') -> GET /api/subscription, emergent-client.ts:87). On native with iapReady it restores purchases first, then falls back to the server check (lines 260-277) - so isSubscribed can no longer stay stale-false on device.

Fix (b) verified: statusLoaded (line 99) is set true in every terminal path of checkSubscription (lines 283, 291, 306); SubscriptionGuard ((tabs)/_layout.tsx:29-34) waits for authLoading=false AND isLoading=false AND statusLoaded=true before redirecting non-subscribers - empirically confirmed: premium cold start never touched /subscription; non-premium cold load never touched tabs.

Fix (c) verified: demo purchase (lines 319-334) throws unless res.is_premium, applies status immediately, re-checks server, and only then router.replace('/(tabs)'); failure branch shows an alert with NO navigation - empirically confirmed with a forced 401 (alert shown, stayed on checkout).
Note: subscription.tsx:699 auto-redirects to /(tabs) whenever isSubscribed flips true - combined with the context replace this double-navigation is harmless (same target).

Note: index.tsx routes on subLoading (isLoading) but not statusLoaded; safe in practice because isSubscribed defaults false and Redirect to /subscription for a racing premium user would self-heal via subscription.tsx:699 once status loads. No flash observed in 3 cold-start runs.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All subscription-guard flows verified. Automation recipe: OTP login needs mongo override (sha256(email:code:JWT_SECRET), JWT_SECRET in backend/.env) - from Playwright scripts use subprocess curl for API calls (Python urllib gets 403 from Cloudflare) and mongosh for the override; tolerate otp/send 502 (email relay 429 under load - OTP doc persists regardless). Storage injection for headless auth: localStorage.setItem('hera_token', JSON.stringify(token)) + hera_onboarded='"true"'. Tab nav via [aria-label=index|discover|vision|journal|profile]; deep-linking page.goto('/profile') lands on Home - click the tab instead. Home greeting text 'what do you want to manifest' (exact=False). App-level OTP limit: 5 sends/10min/email (clear db.otp_log to reset). delivered@resend.dev is is_premium=true. If email relay is 429-ing, wait ~2 min or rely on the mongo override (works even when otp/send 502s, since OTP insert precedes the send).
rca_of_issue: REVIEWED BUGS (fixed by E1, verified): (1) 'Store Not Ready' + subscription never active on device - root cause as reported: SubscriptionContext auto-check effect bailed on native (`if (!iapReady && Platform.OS !== 'web') return`) so status was never fetched, and the guard raced auth/status loading. (2) Failed payment landing on Home unsubscribed - root cause: demo path navigated unconditionally after the API call. Verification: all fixed paths exercised end-to-end (happy, cold-start x2, non-premium guard, forced-401 failure) with zero regressions; the only defect found in this area was the Settings plan-badge 'annual' vs 'yearly' comparison (fixed by T1, profile.tsx:678,681) and confirmed live.
